newsitem.title: USA: Abbott, Metabolex to develop products for diabetes.
newsitem.headline: Abbott, Metabolex to develop products for diabetes.

text.p: Abbott Laboratories Inc and Metabolex Inc said Tuesday they reached two worldwide research and development licensing agreements aimed at the discovery and development of products for people with diabetes.
Metabolex will collaborate with Abbott on the discovery of drugs to treat diabetes and the development of nutritional products for people with the disease.
Under terms of the agreements, Abbott said it made a $4 million equity investment and Metabolex secured $29.5 million through private placement financing.

"These agreements, coupled with our acquisition of MediSense Inc last year and our strong position in clinical testing and nutritional products, emphasize Abbott's intention to be a major participant in diabetes disease management," said Steve Weger, Abbott vice president, corporate planning and development.

Abbott said it is responsible for preclinical and clinical development of any drug leads emerging from the joint program and for government approval, manufacturing, marketing and sales. Metabolex will receive milestone payments and royalties on eventual product sales.

Abbott and Metabolex also agreed to collaborate on developing an orally active, glucose-lowering substance called Insulin Potentiating Factor for use as an ingredient in nutritional products for people with diabetes.

Abbott will have exclusive worldwide rights to use IPF in medical foods, dietary supplements and food products, and the company will provide research funding and the development, manufacturing, marketing and sales resources needed to bring products to market. Metabolex will receive milestone payments and royalties on eventual product sales.
Metabolex is a privately held company founded to develop therapeutics for diabetes and related metabolic diseases.
